case.presentation: Incidental 8 mm solid pulmonary nodule, RUL, on staging chest CT for a 62-year-old smoker.
case.context: Patient is a 62-year-old smoker (30 pack-years) with an incidentally noted 8 mm spiculated RUL nodule. No prior imaging available.

ground_truth.notes: Canonical 6-8 mm high-risk anchor case. Per Fleischner 2017 Table 1A, the 6-8mm bin recommendation is the SAME for low- and high-risk (CT 6-12mo then 18-24mo). Spiculated morphology not used by oracle but realistic for high-risk presentation.
